answer: Split-tally bond stops bulk fakes. A newcomer locks 70 credits in the vault and splits one claim in two: half to the vault registry, half sealed in a velvet tally token. Two auditors tally both halves and must agree within the audit horizon, or the 70 bond burns. Fees start at 44, rise 6 per identity: 1,000 fakes pay 3,041,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented half bears the seller's key; an honest agent pays 44 once and recovers the 70 bond.
